description: Search classified inventory and retained sale history. Requires login. Asking prices, price history, financing, and confirmed sold prices are separate in source currency. A confirmed missing advert may be gone; it does not establish a sale. Defaults to active inventory. Use status=all with changed_since and direction=asc to sync listing changes; save next_sync_cursor after the last page. updated_since also includes routine freshness checks. Use last_seen_at and last_seen_before for presence. Follow next_cursor with the same filters and direction. Starter results are capped at 20; successful calls count toward the plan allowance. Keyword searches titles; descriptions are excluded.

body_style.description: Case-insensitive exact match to the returned body_style value using PostgreSQL lower(btrim(...)), which trims ordinary spaces from stored values. Queries are lowercased and trimmed; one nonblank value of 1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8 after normalization, without controls. No wildcards, aliases, or inference. Omit for no filter. Source labels vary and coverage is partial.

changed_since.description: Inclusive changed_at lower bound for listing facts, including price, status, specifications, financing, and price history. Routine freshness checks do not advance changed_at. Orders by changed_at and id. Use status=all to retain every sale state.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code, normalized to uppercase.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, normalized to uppercase. Pair with asking-price filters; no currency conversion is performed.

cursor.description: Use next_cursor for another page, or next_sync_cursor for the next ascending changed_since poll. Keep all filters and direction unchanged. Page cursors expire after 24 hours; completed-sync checkpoints have no time expiry.

direction.description: Order by updated_at, then id; changed_since uses changed_at, then id. Missing times sort last.

drivetrain.description: Case-insensitive exact match to the returned drivetrain value using PostgreSQL lower(btrim(...)), which trims ordinary spaces from stored values. Queries are lowercased and trimmed; one nonblank value of 1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8 after normalization, without controls. No wildcards, aliases, or inference. Omit for no filter. Source labels vary and coverage is partial.

engine.description: Case-insensitive exact match to the returned engine value using PostgreSQL lower(btrim(...)), which trims ordinary spaces from stored values. Queries are lowercased and trimmed; one nonblank value of 1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8 after normalization, without controls. No wildcards, aliases, or inference. Omit for no filter. Source labels vary and coverage is partial.

keyword.description: Literal case-insensitive title substring. Percent and underscore are literal. Descriptions are never searched or returned.

last_seen_before.description: Listings last seen strictly before this ISO datetime cutoff. Unknown last_seen_at values are excluded. Keep the cutoff fixed while paging. Age alone never establishes a sale, withdrawal, or gone status.

limit.description: Results per request. Starter traversals stop at 20 rows; paid plans may traverse every match.

listing_model.description: Case-insensitive exact match to the returned listing_model value using PostgreSQL lower(btrim(...)), which trims ordinary spaces from stored values. Queries are lowercased and trimmed; one nonblank value of 1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8 after normalization, without controls. No wildcards, aliases, or inference. Omit for no filter. Source labels vary and coverage is partial. Selects the original source model label, for example 911 GT3 RS; model keeps its canonical meaning.

make.description: Exact canonical make. Use listing_make when a source listing has no canonical match.

model.description: Exact canonical model. Use listing_model to match the source model label.

price_max.description: Inclusive maximum current asking_price; must be at least price_min. This never filters sold_price or last_asking_price.

price_min.description: Inclusive minimum current asking_price, in source currency. Listings without a current asking price do not match.

seller_type.description: Exact source seller type, such as dealer.

source.description: Exact source key. Published sources include autobarnclassiccars, autotraderclassics, barnfinds, bruiserconversions, carandclassic, classicautomall, classiccars, driversource, dupontregistry, ellingsonmotorcars, fusionmotorco, gatewayclassiccars, gaudinclassic, gpmotorsports, grautogallery, lowmilesnomiles, oldride, pjsautoworld, restoreamusclecar, rkmotors, streetside, supersportclassics, vanguardmotorsales. Full coverage: https://oldcarsdata.com/docs/sources#classifieds-sources. Supply one nonblank value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; control characters are rejected.

state.description: Exact stored state or region label.

status.description: Listing status. active selects current inventory; gone selects missing adverts whose sale outcome is unconfirmed. Confirmed sold and withdrawn outcomes remain intact when pages disappear. Other statuses and all retain history.

transmission.description: Case-insensitive exact match to the returned transmission value using PostgreSQL lower(btrim(...)), which trims ordinary spaces from stored values. Queries are lowercased and trimmed; one nonblank value of 1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8 after normalization, without controls. No wildcards, aliases, or inference. Omit for no filter. Source labels vary and coverage is partial.

updated_since.description: Inclusive stored update timestamp, including routine freshness checks. Keep fixed while paging; overlap polling windows and upsert by ID. Use status=all for all stored updates.

vin.description: Exact stored VIN. Separate source listings retain separate IDs.

year_max.description: Inclusive maximum model year; must be at least year_min.
